description: Modify payment_transactions.submission_id FK constraint to be nullable, allowing payment transactions to be recorded before submission row exists. This is the foundational schema change enabling payment-first security flow. Current bug: record_payment_transaction fails with FK violation when called with pre-generated submission_id that doesn't exist yet.
steps: Create supabase/migrations/065_nullable_submission_id_for_payments.sql with ALTER TABLE statement to drop NOT NULL constraint on submission_id column
Add CHECK constraint: verified_payments_have_submission that ensures verified=false OR submission_id IS NOT NULL (verified payments must be linked to a submission)

Add SQL comment explaining the nullable design: 'submission_id is nullable to support payment-first flow where payment is recorded before submission row exists. The check constraint ensures verified payments are always linked to a valid submission.'
Keep all existing indexes unchanged (idx_payment_transactions_submission still works with NULLs)
Keep FK cascade behavior: ON DELETE CASCADE still applies when submission_id is set
acceptance_criteria: Can INSERT payment_transactions row with submission_id = NULL
Can UPDATE submission_id from NULL to valid UUID after submission created
Cannot set verified=true when submission_id is NULL (constraint violation expected)
FK cascade still deletes payment when linked submission is deleted
Migration 065 runs without errors in Supabase SQL Editor
verification: Run migration 065 in Supabase SQL Editor - should complete without errors
Execute test SQL from security-impl-plan.md section 'FEAT-001 Verification' to verify nullable behavior and constraint enforcement
Check schema: SELECT column_name, is_nullable, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='payment_transactions' AND column_name='submission_id' - should show is_nullable='YES'
findings:
Migration 065 created successfully. SQL syntax verified. The migration:
1. Drops NOT NULL constraint on payment_transactions.submission_id
2. Adds CHECK constraint verified_payments_have_submission ensuring verified=false OR submission_id IS NOT NULL
3. Preserves all existing indexes and FK cascade behavior
4. Includes comprehensive comments explaining the payment-first flow rationale

Ready for manual execution in Supabase SQL Editor. Next steps should verify the constraint works as expected before implementing record_payment_transaction changes.
